odoo - A suite of open source business apps: CRM, e-commerce, accounting, inventory, and thousands of community modules.
Odoo | Suite of business apps including CRM, accounting and inventory

summary.one_liner: Odoo is a suite of web-based open source business apps covering CRM, website building, eCommerce, accounting, inventory, and more, which can be combined into a full ERP.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Odoo as a suite of web-based open source business applications. Named apps include CRM, Website Builder, eCommerce, Warehouse Management, Project Management, Billing and Accounting, Point of Sale, Human Resources, Marketing, and Manufacturing. Apps can run standalone or be installed together and integrate with each other to form a full-featured ERP. The README points to setup instructions in the documentation for a standard installation, plus eLearning, a business game called Scale-up, and developer tutorials. It also links a Responsible Disclosure page for security reports. The README itself does not include install commands.
use_cases: build and host a company website with eCommerce
track CRM leads and sales pipeline
how_to_run: See the Setup instructions in the official Odoo documentation for a standard installation
notable: Modular apps that integrate into a single ERP
Covers CRM, eCommerce, accounting, inventory, POS, HR, and manufacturing
Has eLearning and a business game for learning the software
caveats: README gives no install commands; setup is deferred to external documentation
Community modules vary in quality (per awesome-python listing describing thousands of community modules)
